name: Buki-Yamaz | Bremen Teater, København [Copenhagen Jazz Festival]
description:
Buki-Yamaz er tilbage efter mere end fire årtiers fravær og spiller koncert på Bremen Teater i København den 4. juli.
——————————————
• Billetpris: 350kr
• Billetsalg: https://www.billetlugen.dk/noapp/event/20712497/?affiliate=BT9
• Døre: kl. 19
• Koncert: kl. 20

Tilmeld dig Bremen Teaters Nyhedsbrev:
https://www.brementeater.dk/nyhedsbrev
——————————————
Efter mere end fire årtiers fravær vender det danske latin-funk-ensemble Buki-Yamaz tilbage til scenen. I december 2025 spiller bandet to eksklusive jubilæumskoncerter i anledning af, at det i år er 50 år siden deres debutalbum udkom i 1975. Begge koncerter gik udsolgt på rekordtid, og nu kommer gruppen til Bremen Teater under sommerens Copenhagen Jazz Festival.

Som et af 70’ernes mest stilskabende orkestre blandede Buki-Yamaz jazz, funk, latin og psykedeliske elementer med en kompromisløs musikalitet og en intens live-energi. I deres korte, men banebrydende karriere nåede de at udgive fem albums på blot fire år, spille op mod 100 koncerter årligt og fast navn på Roskilde Festival fra 1974 til 1979.

Nu genopstår gruppen med flere originale medlemmer. Koncerterne på Hotel Cecil og Bremen Teater bliver en sjælden mulighed for at opleve denne markante del af dansk musikhistorie i levende live.‍

- Line-up‍ -
Oilly Wallace: Fløjte & saxofon 
Ben Besiakov: Keyboards
Mikkel Nordsø: Guitar
Kim Sagild: Guitar
Kim Yarbrough: Bas
Ethan Weisgard: Trommer
Tira Skamby: Percussion
Jesper Nørløv Arnholtz: Percussion

Buki-Yamaz blev dannet i midten af 1970’erne og var et toneangivende navn på den danske og skandinaviske live-scene. Med deres unikke blanding af genrer og en stærk visuel og musikalsk identitet skilte de sig ud og inspirerede en hel generation af musikere. Bandets albums er i dag eftertragtede samlerobjekter.

name: DR Big Band, Ivan Lins & New York Voices | DR Koncerthuset | Koncertsalen
description:
Brasiliansk musiks grand old man Ivan Lins møder DR Big Band og vokalgruppen New York Voices som del af Copenhagen Jazz Festival 2026. Ti år efter deres første møde bliver der igen fyret op for brasilianske rytmer, bløde vokaler og lækre harmonier i et brag af en releasekoncert for et nyt, fælles album.

Den legendariske brasilianske komponist og musiker Ivan Lins blev opdaget af Quincy Jones i 1979. Siden dengang har han turneret i det meste af verden, og stjerner som Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan og Sting har indspillet hans sange – sidstnævnte med en Grammy som resultat.

Denne sommeraften i DR Koncerthuset kan du opleve et længe ventet musikalsk gensyn mellem Ivan Lins, de fire topvokalister i New York Voices og et veloplagt DR Big Band. Der er gået ti år siden de sidst stod sammen på scenen i Koncertsalen, men nu er tiden inde til udgivelsen af det fælles album, som blev indspillet dengang – og det skal fejres!

Aftenen byder på en forførende blanding af MPB, bossanova, samba, pop og funk i geniale arrangementer for bigband og vokal af tyske Ralf Schmidt. Koncerten er en del af Copenhagen Jazz Festival 2026, og som optakt har produktionen været på turné til Jazz Baltica i Tyskland.

Glæd dig til en aften fuld af varme, rytmer, lækker bigband-lyd og masser af formidabel vokal.

description:

Første koncert: døre 17:00, show 17.30
Anden koncert: døre 20.00, show 21.00
Entré: 200 kr. 
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○

Under Copenhagen Jazz Festival inviterer Girls In Airports og strygetrioen Halvcirkel til to eksklusive koncerter på Xenon i Huset i Magstræde.

Koncerterne tager udgangspunkt i Imaginal, det fælles værk, hvor nordiske strygerklange møder Girls In Airports’ karakteristiske rytmiske og melodiske univers. Musikken bevæger sig mellem jazz, ambient, folk og kammermusik og udfolder sig i et åbent felt mellem struktur og intuition.

Imaginal voksede frem over halvandet år gennem lange sessioner i København, hvor de syv musikere udviklede et fælles sprog præget af tillid, nysgerrighed og lysten til at lade musikken tage den tid, den behøver.

Jazznyt kaldte albummet “et af Girls In Airports’ stærkeste udspil” og beskrev mødet mellem de to ensembler som en rejse, “hvor man holder hinanden i hånden og på turen mødes i ånden.”

Også live har samarbejdet vist sig som noget særligt. I en anmeldelse fra Vinterjazz 2026 skrev Gaffa, at mødet mellem Girls In Airports og Halvcirkel var “et perfekt match”, og at musikken fremstod “innovativ og visionær, fri af snærende rammer.”

360-graders koncert
I Xenons teatersal opbygges koncerterne i en 360-graders opsætning, hvor publikum placeres tæt omkring musikerne. Her får samarbejdet mulighed for at folde sig ud i et intimt og rumligt format, hvor detaljerne i samspillet træder tydeligt frem, og hvor værket kan opleves tæt på.

De to koncerter er en sjælden mulighed for at opleve Imaginal live i et format, hvor både værkets ro, tyngde og bevægelse kan stå klart.

--------------------------

ENG.

Please note that there will be two concerts, one at 5:00 PM and one at 8:00 PM. Please make sure you have purchased a ticket for the concert of your choice.

Also check out Girls In Airports’ other concerts during the Jazz Festival:
Girls In Airports - The Early Years & The Coming
Girls In Airports x Teitur

Venue: Xenon, 4th floor
First concert: doors 5:00 PM, show 5:30 PM
Second concert: doors 8:00 PM, show 9:00 PM
Admission: 200 DKK
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○

During the Copenhagen Jazz Festival, Girls In Airports and the string trio Halvcirkel invite you to two exclusive concerts at Xenon in Huset on Magstræde.

The concerts are based on Imaginal, the collaborative work where Nordic string sounds meet Girls In Airports’ characteristic rhythmic and melodic universe. The music moves between jazz, ambient, folk, and chamber music, unfolding in an open space between structure and intuition.

Imaginal took shape over a year and a half through long sessions in Copenhagen, where the seven musicians developed a shared language marked by trust, curiosity, and the desire to let the music take the time it needs.

Jazznyt called the album “one of Girls In Airports’ strongest releases” and described the meeting between the two ensembles as a journey “where you hold each other’s hands and, along the way, meet in spirit.”

This collaboration has also proven to be something special in a live setting. In a review from Vinterjazz 2026, Gaffa wrote that the meeting between Girls In Airports and Halvcirkel was “a perfect match,” and that the music came across as “innovative and visionary, free from restrictive constraints.”

360-degree setup
In Xenon’s theater hall, the concerts are staged in a 360-degree setup, with the audience seated close around the musicians. Here, the collaboration has the opportunity to unfold in an intimate and spatial format, where the details of the interplay come clearly to the fore, and where the work can be experienced up close.

The two concerts offer a rare opportunity to experience Imaginal live in a format where the work’s tranquility, weight, and movement can all be clearly felt.

Under Copenhagen Jazz Festival inviterer Girls in Airports og den færøske sangskriver Teitur til to eksklusive koncerter på Xenon i Huset i Magstræde.

Når færøske folkesange møder moderne jazz, opstår et musikalsk sprog, der føles både urgammelt og nyt. Det er udgangspunktet for samarbejdet mellem det danske indie-jazzband Girls in Airports og den færøske sangskriver Teitur.

Samarbejdet begyndte i 2022 og blev første gang præsenteret i et udsolgt VEGA. Siden har projektet foldet sig ud på scener over hele Danmark – fra Tønder og Aarhus til DR Koncerthuset i København – og senest på Færøerne, hvor musikken vendte hjem til sine rødder i en række bevægende koncerter, der for alvor bandt tråden mellem tradition og fornyelse.

Resultatet for samarbejdet er et organisk lydunivers, hvor nordatlantisk poesi møder moderne jazz, indie og elektroniske teksturer. Som GAFFA skrev i sin femstjernede anmeldelse: “Et poetisk højdepunkt, hvor Teiturs ro og Girls in Airports’ levende klangflader smelter sammen til noget tidløst.”

As part of the Copenhagen Jazz Festival, Girls in Airports and Faroese singer-songwriter Teitur invite you to two exclusive concerts at Xenon in Huset in Magstræde.

When Faroese folk songs meet modern jazz, a musical language emerges that feels both ancient and new. This is the starting point for the collaboration between the Danish indie jazz band Girls in Airports and the Faroese songwriter Teitur.

The collaboration began in 2022 and was first presented at a sold-out VEGA. Since then, the project has unfolded on stages across Denmark—from Tønder and Aarhus to DR Concert Hall in Copenhagen—and most recently in the Faroe Islands, where the music returned to its roots in a series of moving concerts that truly connected tradition and renewal.

The result of the collaboration is an organic sonic universe where North Atlantic poetry meets modern jazz, indie, and electronic textures. As GAFFA wrote in its five-star review: “A poetic highlight, where Teitur’s calm and Girls in Airports’ vibrant soundscapes merge into something timeless.”

360-degree setup

Here, the collaboration has the opportunity to unfold in an intimate and spatial format, where the details of the interplay come clearly to the fore, and where the work can be experienced up close.

name: FÅ BILLETTER! Mezzoforte | Bremen Teater, København
description:
Mezzoforte tænder op for Bremen Teater med deres solide og groovy fusionsjazz-funk.
——————————————
• Billetpris: 370 - 420kr
• Venteliste: https://www.billetlugen.dk/noapp/event/20884791/?affiliate=BT9
• Døre: kl. 19
• Koncert: kl. 20

Tilmeld dig Bremen Teaters Nyhedsbrev:
https://www.brementeater.dk/nyhedsbrev
——————————————
‍Mezzoforte bragede gennem lydmuren med deres kæmpehit ’Garden Party’ i 1983 og har siden udbredt deres solide groovy nordatlantisk fusionsjazz-funk til hele verden. Eythor, Fridrik og Johann udgør den oprindelige kerne i bandet og kemien den samme, når gruppen fra Reykjavik indtager Bremen Teater i juli 2026.

De har holdt sammen i 40 år, og spillede derfor bl.a. to udsolgte jubilæums shows i Reykjavik i september 2017. Det var Steinar Berg der tidligt så potentialet i bandet. Det tog fire albums at få hul igennem til hitlisterne, og med albummet Surprise Surprise fra 1982 ramte Mezzoforte både hitlister og diskotekernes dansegulve med ’Garden Party’ der i øvrigt blev arrangeret af Chris Cameron.

Drengene fra Island leverer altid energiske koncerter, der kombinerer virtuose instrumentaleimprovisationer med deres velkendte melodiske temaer, og Mezzoforte er således den lækre lyd af sportslørdag bare live, tilsat masser af energi og stor intakt spilleglæde.

description:
Mari Froes kommer til Bremen Teater med varme og sensuelle bølger af MPB, bossa nova og samba.
——————————————
• Billetpris: 380kr
• Billetsalg: https://www.billetlugen.dk/noapp/event/20993742/?affiliate=BT9
• Døre: kl. 18
• Koncert: kl. 19

Tilmeld dig Bremen Teaters Nyhedsbrev:
https://www.brementeater.dk/nyhedsbrev
——————————————
São Paulo-fødte Mari Froes har placeret sig i front for den nye bølge af MPB (Música Popular Brasileira), som i hendes sensuelle univers smelter sømløst sammen med varm bossa nova, samba og jazz. 

Hun indtog COLORS med en smuk fortolkning af den brasilianske sang Gabriela, og med en signing på pladeselskabet 777 Music Group er Froes for alvor på raketfart mod stjernerne.

Efter hendes koncert på Hotel Cecil gik udsolgt på rekordtid, vender hun nu tilbage til Danmark til sommer med en koncert på Bremen Teater under Copenhagen Jazz Festival.

name: Musical table read series
description:
A social series for musical lovers. Come sing through the score of a musical, have a few drinks, and make some friends! Sign up by writing to cphmusicals@gmail.com to get more details.

We choose a musical in advance and send it to our mailing list. Those who wish to join sign up and will be assigned parts in advance so you can prepare. On the day of, we meet along with our wonderful piano accompanist and sing through the entire score, including reading the libretto (script) if applicable.

RSVP - TICKET
To help ensure we cover our costs — and to try to avoid last-minute cancellations — we ask that you MobilePay 50 kr to our Box account: 5896PH

When you arrive, you can get one free drink (wine, beer, or soda). If you can’t make it at the last minute, the 50 kr is not refundable.

name: The Honker & The Tickler | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
The Honker & The Tickler ragtime duo revive the playfulness of 1920s and 1930s ragtime blues with heartfelt authenticity and drive. Maksim Sorokin on blues harp, washboard, and vocals, and Daniel Rodrigues on banjo, guitar, foot percussion, and vocals, the duo captures the raw, rhythmic energy of early American roots music.
Drawing inspiration from icons like Blind Boy Fuller, their performances bridge past and present, blending historical reverence with lively, street-corner spontaneity.

Line-up:

Maksim Sorokin (Blues Harp/Washboard/Vocal), Daniel Rodrigues (Banjo/Guitar/Foot percussion/Vocal)

Line-up:

Karin Juhl, vokal
Daniel Van Kranendonk, guitar

name: TRANQUEBAR | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
In its early years, Tranquebar helped revive the tradition of street musicians in Copenhagen. From the summer of 2011 onwards, Tranquebar has played countless unannounced intimate concerts at pubs and street corners. The first took place at Fingerbøllet's pool table in Christianshavn and since then there have been many late nights and early mornings at legendary watering holes such as Lille Peter, Stefanshus, Riesen, Karusellen, Lord Nelson and Børges Bodega - in addition to the regular jazz festival gigs at HUSET.
Tranquebar has released several EPs and two albums. The latest album 'Ø' was recorded on the four Danish islands of Sejerø, Endelave, Møn and Fejø and has received critical acclaim and has been played on various international radio stations.

Line-up:

Grit Jansen (vokal), Nicolai Kaarsen (banjo), Anders Munk (Harmonika), Anders Bo Eriksen (Helikon), Michael Eich-Høilund (cajon).

name: Girls In Airports - The Early Years & The Coming | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
Please note that there are two concerts: one at 5:00 PM and one at 8:00 PM. Make sure that you have purchased a ticket for the desired concert.

First concert – The Early Years

The first concert dives into the early releases: Girls In Airports, Migration, and Kaikoura.

This revisits a period when the band tapped into something essential in its time—a form of jazz that was not elitist and that opened itself to sounds from around the world. At a time when the internet truly began connecting us globally, a new musical sensibility emerged, of which these albums were a part.

The music from that era is melodic and atmospheric, at times almost naive—but it is precisely in this simplicity that a special vitality and sense of freedom arises, setting the musicians free. The new arrangements open up the material and let it live from where the band stands today. The music carries an open, warm expression that still feels relevant.

Second concert – The Coming

The later concert moves into more recent years with music from Dive, How It Is Now, and Leap—as well as brand new material.

The band will be joined by saxophonist César Joaniquet, whom they met while working on Leap in collaboration with Aarhus Jazz Orchestra. Since then, the collaboration has continued to evolve, including through a residency in 2026 where new music has been created.

The expression moves in a more transcendent direction—with greater openness and more direct improvisation. After several years of three ambitious artistic collaborations, there is now a strong energy in returning to the core of the group and exploring their collective interplay with renewed freedom and inspiration. A concert that asks the question: where does the music go next?

360-degree setup

The concerts take place in Xenon’s theatre hall, where a 360-degree setup is created with the audience closely surrounding the musicians. Here, the music is not just performed but experienced as a shared space—a continuous flow in motion, where presence, dynamics, and collective interplay are at the center.

Also check out other concerts by Girls In Airports during the Jazz Festival:

Girls In Airports x Halvcirkel
Girls In Airports x Teitur

name: The Rainbow Smuggler | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
After a long journey from the swamps of New Orleans and across the Arctic ice sheet, the urban legend buffalo returns to his home in the city. But the city ain't the city anymore. The streets have shifted, the walls have new colours, and the ghosts learned new songs. Drawing inspiration from roots rock, swamp blues, cabaret, fusion jazz and funk, the Rainbow Smuggler takes you on a lyrical journey through the postmodern urban landscape. From the mind of Rasmus Sørensen emerge songs of beauty, transition and decay. The buffalo is back. And he brought a band.

Line-up:

Rasmus Sørensen (vocals, percussion), Wim Verbruggen (contrabass), Valentina Cárcamo Landon (piano), Michalis Zisopoulos (drums, percussion), Armando Petrella (bass trumpet), Evangelos Dimopoulos (saxophone, flute)

name: Unicum Trio | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
Performed in a dynamic trio setting with electric guitar, bass and drums, the simple folk melodies are reborn with a new original sound.

name: Girls In Airports x Teitur | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
Please note that there are two concerts: one at 5:00 PM and one at 8:00 PM. Make sure that you have purchased a ticket for the desired concert.

When Faroese folk songs meet modern jazz, a musical language emerges that feels both ancient and new. This is the starting point for the collaboration between the Danish indie jazz band Girls in Airports and the Faroese songwriter Teitur.

The collaboration began in 2022 and was first presented at a sold-out VEGA. Since then, the project has unfolded on stages across Denmark—from Tønder and Aarhus to DR Concert Hall in Copenhagen—and most recently in the Faroe Islands, where the music returned to its roots in a series of moving concerts that truly connected tradition and renewal.

The result of the collaboration is an organic sonic universe where North Atlantic poetry meets modern jazz, indie, and electronic textures. As GAFFA wrote in its five-star review: “A poetic highlight, where Teitur’s calm and Girls in Airports’ vibrant soundscapes merge into something timeless.”

360-degree koncert

In Xenon’s theater hall, the concerts are staged in a 360-degree setup, with the audience seated close around the musicians. Here, the collaboration has the opportunity to unfold in an intimate and spatial format, where the details of the interplay come clearly to the fore, and where the work can be experienced up close.

Also check out other concerts by Girls In Airports during the Jazz Festival:

Girls In Airports x Halvcirkel
Girls In Airports - The Early Years & The Coming

name: North Folk | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
North Folk is five ordinary people. Our connection with the audience is present and intense; a quiet sense of intimacy that grows between musicians and listeners. The music is like worn wagon wheels through the dust of the prairie, like the melancholic silence in deep forests, and like the storm shaking the towering pines of the Rocky Mountains.

Line-up:

Mai Kjeldgaard (Lead vocal, guitar, piano)

Jonas Holst Ladefoged (Lead vocal, guitar, piano),

Jacob Rozario (Drums, backup vocal), Tue Damskov (Lead guitar, backup vocal)

Theodor Thomsen (Bas, backup vocal)

name: The Pølsehorns | CPH Jazz Festival
description:
Immerse yourself in the vibrant sounds of our youthful brass band at the jazz festival. Our dynamic ensemble offers a diverse array of musical experiences, ranging from electrifying arrangements of pop hits to soulful renditions of rock classics, pulsating techno beats, and smooth jazz melodies. With each performance, we inject our signature energy and groove into every genre, ensuring a memorable and dancing experience for all.

Line-up:

Rámi (Baryton Sax), Rohan (Tenor Sax), Zoé (Trumpet), Stepan (Trombone), Ivan (Trombone), Jason (Trombone), Simon (Euphonium), Nicolas (Euphonium), Thomas (Sousaphone), Amedeo (Drums).
